component.name: MovieItem
component.script:
sub init() m.poster = m.top.findNode("poster") m.title = m.top.findNode("title") m.checkLabel = m.top.findNode("checkLabel") m.focusRect = m.top.findNode("focusRect") m.placeholder = m.top.findNode("placeholder") m.placeholderLabel = m.top.findNode("placeholderLabel") m.watchedBadge = m.top.findNode("watchedBadge") m.watchedLabel = m.top.findNode("watchedLabel") m.poster.observeField("loadStatus", "onPosterLoadStatus") end sub
sub onContentChange() item = m.top.itemContent if item <> invalid m.placeholder.visible = true m.placeholderLabel.visible = true m.poster.visible = false m.poster.uri = item.hdPosterUrl
isW = false if item.shortDescription <> invalid and item.shortDescription = "watched" isW = true end if
' Palomita verde antes del título if isW m.checkLabel.text = "✓ " m.checkLabel.visible = true m.title.translation = [28, 258] m.title.width = 153 else m.checkLabel.text = "" m.checkLabel.visible = false m.title.translation = [4, 258] m.title.width = 177 end if m.title.text = item.title
if m.watchedBadge <> invalid m.watchedBadge.visible = isW m.watchedLabel.visible = isW end if end if end sub
sub onPosterLoadStatus() status = m.poster.loadStatus if status = "ready" m.placeholder.visible = false m.placeholderLabel.visible = false m.poster.visible = true else if status = "failed" m.placeholder.visible = true m.placeholderLabel.visible = true m.poster.visible = false end if end sub
sub onFocusChange() focused = m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 m.focusRect.visible = focused if focused m.title.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" else m.title.color = "0xCCCCCCFF" end if end sub
